observations: Photo 0 shows a front view of a Kyocera printer with a black and white body, a control panel on the right, and an open top output tray.
The brand 'KYOCERA' and model 'ECOSYS P4040dn' are clearly visible on a black label on the top front of the printer in photo 0.
An 'A3' label is visible on the lower right side of the front panel in photo 0, indicating paper size capability.
Photo 1 shows a slightly angled front view of the same printer, with the same branding visible, though less clearly.
Both photos have a watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI GOLD TECHNOLOGIES' overlaid, suggesting a listing from a reseller or marketplace.
The printer appears clean and undamaged in both photos, with no visible dents, scratches, or wear.

claims.claim: Kyocera Ecosys P4040dn A3 LaserJet Printer
claims.evidence: Photo 0 clearly shows the brand and model name on the front label, and the 'A3' label is visible on the front panel.

claims.claim: Direct Tokunbo — super clean and fully functional!
claims.evidence: Photos show the printer appears clean, but there is no visual proof of functionality. 'Tokunbo' (imported used) is a claim about origin, not verifiable from photos alone.

risks.risk: Printer may not be fully functional (e.g., toner issues, paper jams, connectivity problems, or internal wear)
risks.proof: A video showing the printer powering on, printing a test page, and handling paper without jams.

risks.risk: Toner or drum cartridge may be depleted or damaged, affecting print quality or causing immediate failure
risks.proof: Photo of the open toner cartridge compartment showing the condition and level of toner, or a printout sample.
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing immediate toner replacement

risks.risk: The printer may have hidden mechanical or electrical damage not visible in photos (e.g., internal fuser damage, motor failure)
risks.proof: Video of the printer in operation, including paper feed, printing, and output, with close-up of internal components during operation.

proof_requests: Video of the printer powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the toner cartridge compartment showing the toner level and condition.
Photo or video of the printer's internal components (fuser, rollers) during operation.
response.reason: The printer's identity is confirmed as a Kyocera Ecosys P4040dn from photo 0. However, claims of functionality and condition cannot be verified from still images alone. Hidden risks such as internal damage, toner depletion, or mechanical failure affect pricing and must be proven before a price can be assigned.
